title: Kimetsu no Yaiba x MLB
content:
Many hardcore fans miss out of obscure collabs like this one. Sometimes its fine, but other times, the collab is so good, it makes you want a full season of it even when it’s about something you have so little interest in. That was me with baseball.

I’m not gonna like, many collabs can feel weird, out of place, and force, however, this one kind of made sense with the whole “breathing” and concentration.

Although, it would have made it better if the flashbacks were omitted.

The effects on the baseball bats were amazing, even for Demon Slayer’s case. Very crism and organically animated. For a short screening,it truly makes you beg for more. That Ufotable MLG is so addicting, man.

Overall 7.1/10.
